differences: White plays the usual chess army. Black plays the Spartans, whose pieces are all different.
The Spartans have two kings, and lose only when they can't keep one of them safe.
The Spartan pawns are hoplites: they move diagonally forward and capture straight ahead.
The Spartans' other pieces are the lieutenant, the general, the warlord and the captain, each with its own way of moving.
